recordType: normalized independent reports and source-verified parent triage
limitations: Bounded source traces, not every-line semantic review of all evidence bytes
Empty lens arrays apply only to recorded scopes

findings.title: Historical copied-skill path omitted
findings.trigger_condition: A copied skill is committed, then deleted; reachable historical trees are scanned.
findings.guard_snippet: treeFindings applies sensitivePath to entry basenames without ancestor context.
findings.potential_consequence: Copied material can escape historical provenance review.

parent_triage.reason_and_prevention: Full scan accepted with zero findings; reconstruct historical file paths and regress deletion.

findings.title: Allowed placeholder rejected
findings.trigger_condition: The only local-projects content is the allowed .gitkeep placeholder.
findings.guard_snippet: Tree directory entries are classified as tracked user data before full file exemption.
findings.potential_consequence: A supported placeholder prevents publication clearance.

parent_triage.reason_and_prevention: Full scan blocked with history:tracked-user-data; separate directory traversal from file classification.

findings.title: No trusted per-content rights resolution input
findings.trigger_condition: A copied or binary item needs a supported approved disposition.
findings.guard_snippet: finding always sets unresolved; policy input only supplies employer terms.
findings.potential_consequence: A prospective approved item has no supported way to clear its finding.

parent_triage.reason_and_prevention: Already recorded by Story 8.7; no real approved asset rejection demonstrated. Define trust/removal contract; never hand-edit clearance.

findings.title: Known PEM signature coverage differs
findings.trigger_condition: Synthetic DSA or encrypted PEM header passes the local hygiene helper.
findings.guard_snippet: Local signature set omits forms recognized by publication scanning.
findings.potential_consequence: Local quality feedback may miss recognized credential material before publication scan.

parent_triage.reason_and_prevention: Synthetic helpers reproduce difference; no actual credential leak. Share complete known signature definitions.

findings.title: UTF-16 payload outside local decoder
findings.trigger_condition: Synthetic UTF-16 signature is inspected locally.
findings.guard_snippet: Local decoding uses UTF-8; publication scanner handles UTF-16 and binary review.
findings.potential_consequence: Local hygiene alone does not establish binary content safety.

parent_triage.reason_and_prevention: Story 8.7 explicitly excludes complete binary/history inspection; publication scanning detects this probe. Retain scope limits.

findings.title: Nested gzip outside local expansion
findings.trigger_condition: A synthetic signature sits beneath two gzip layers.
findings.guard_snippet: Local scanner expands one gzip layer; publication scanner recurses.
findings.potential_consequence: Local hygiene alone does not establish nested archive safety.

parent_triage.reason_and_prevention: Publication scanning detects this probe; retain explicitly bounded local hygiene rather than inventing a duplicate requirement.

findings.title: JSON-escaped Windows home path missed
findings.trigger_condition: A tracked JSON string contains a synthetic Windows home path.
findings.guard_snippet: Raw backslash matching does not inspect decoded JSON strings.
findings.potential_consequence: Private home paths in JSON evidence can receive false publication acceptance.

parent_triage.reason_and_prevention: Raw path detected; full scan of serialized path accepted with zero findings. Inspect decoded representations alongside raw content.

findings.title: Private IPv4 URL not classified
findings.trigger_condition: An RFC1918 URL appears in text.
findings.guard_snippet: Private URL classifier uses selected suffixes, not address ranges.
findings.potential_consequence: An actual organizational endpoint could remain outside this automatic review category.

parent_triage.reason_and_prevention: Helper omission reproduced, but generic examples may be legitimate. Retain manual privacy judgment; define policy before blanket rejection.

findings.title: Import-equals condition misclassified
findings.trigger_condition: TypeScript external import-equals syntax selects a conditional public export.
findings.guard_snippet: sourceImports marks require only for a require call, otherwise import.
findings.potential_consequence: Wrong conditional entry can be used for a boundary decision.

parent_triage.reason_and_prevention: Synthetic AST result is import. Add require/import conditional-export controls; no current workspace failure proven.

findings.title: All named type-only import misclassified
findings.trigger_condition: Every named import specifier is type-only.
findings.guard_snippet: Classification does not aggregate per-specifier type-only flags.
findings.potential_consequence: A type-only public export can be evaluated as runtime and falsely rejected.

parent_triage.reason_and_prevention: Synthetic AST result is import. Regress types/runtime conditions; no current workspace failure proven.

adversarial.scope: Full epic diff available; publication/history/hygiene/boundary gates examined; primary-source parent reprobes retained.

edge-case-hunter.scope: Migration, Restore, archive/JSON/version, release, advisory/publication and quality paths; not full UI/native/hosted/historical evidence bytes.

verification-gap.scope: Substantive assertions in relevant migration/Restore/archive/version/release/publication/quality tests; not all UI/platform or retained evidence bytes.
